title: FUJIFILM GFX100RF Large Format Rangefinder
purpose: Portable large-format rangefinder form factor for travel, environmental portraiture, documentary, and landscape with maximum resolution and analog film simulation color science.

sensor_and_optics.camera_system: FUJIFILM GFX100RF (102MP GFX CMOS II Large Format)
sensor_and_optics.sensor_type: 43.8x32.9mm Large Format GFX CMOS II with X-Processor 5
sensor_and_optics.lens: Fujinon GF 50mm f/3.5 R LM WR stopped down to f/5.6 optical sweet spot
sensor_and_optics.dynamic_range: 16-bit raw tonal latitude with Fujifilm analog color science (Classic Chrome / Reala Ace)
sensor_and_optics.shutter: Focal-plane shutter with 1/125s flash sync and high-speed electronic shutter

lighting_and_exposure.primary_lighting: Natural ambient directional daylight with subtle reflector bounce, base ISO 80, 16-bit raw capture
lighting_and_exposure.light_transport: Open environmental light transport, soft shadow graduation, authentic analog highlight roll-off

surface_rendering: Natural epidermal skin texture with resolved pores, fine vellus hair, and accurate subsurface scattering
True material micro-relief: fabric weave, weathered stone, foliage micro-textures
Organic acutance without digital edge ringing or clarity boosts
depth_and_optics: Natural large-format environmental separation with subtle focal falloff
Rectilinear optical projection, zero edge distortion

execution_directive: Enforce FUJIFILM GFX100RF 102MP large-format documentary fidelity with authentic Classic Chrome / Reala Ace tonal depth. Eliminate digital sharpening, synthetic smoothing, and plastic textures.
